remarks: Set on a flat property with flexible living spaces and a wonderful Noroton Heights location just 0.6 miles from the train, 2 Fairfield Avenue offers an inviting blend of comfort, character, and convenience.  The open kitchen is at the heart of the home, with a separate living room, family/TV room, playroom or home office, and convenient first-floor powder room. French doors between the kitchen/dining area and the living room with fireplace allow for more defined spaces when desired. A first-floor ensuite bedroom can serve as a primary suite, guest room, or fourth bedroom, while three additional bedrooms and a spacious full bath are upstairs.  The partially finished lower level offers space for a workout area, playroom or additional family room, spacious laundry, and plenty of storage.  The flat property offers generous outdoor space, from a bluestone terrace off the family room to a large lawn with a storage shed, framed by mature shade trees and privacy hedges.  Improvements include a redesigned and waterproofed basement with new flooring and enclosed sump pump system, new kitchen appliances, updated trim, crown molding and baseboards, an expanded smart-home system, and landscaping. Ideally located near the Noroton Heights train station, Heights Commons, beaches, parks, playgrounds, Little League fields, shopping, and dining.
